Chapter 434: Chapter 8 Grey Gourd (Please Subscribe)_2

The female evolver spoke softly.

“Follow me?”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged.

As a student of Chikun Starlord, he already had many followers.

“What do you want?” Lin Yuan asked directly.

Once the decision to follow was made, Lin Yuan would control their fate, and not even the three Goddesses could intervene.

...

Thus, followers must have their own desires.

When Heiyu Mo of the Heiyu Family decided to follow the Chikun Starlord, his request was to establish a family legacy.

That’s why there was a time when the Heiyu Family shone brilliantly in the Chikun Star Domain.

“After stepping into the Eighth Layer, we deeply feel the hardship of cultivation, so in the future, if Starlord can step into the Ninth Layer, just giving us some guidance would suffice,” Lu Ran said respectfully.

Although the virtual world of human civilization contains some cultivation experiences of Ninth Rank Evolvers,

those are personal experiences of Ninth Rank Evolvers which don’t offer much help to them.

But how difficult is it to receive personal guidance from a Ninth Rank Evolver?

“No problem,”

Lin Yuan consented in just a moment’s thought.

Simply giving some guidance couldn’t be easier.

Now that he had begun to take charge of the Milky Way Star Region, he urgently needed a large number of subordinates, and two Eighth Rank Evolvers could save him a lot of trouble.

Moreover, Lu Ran and Ruan Wei had clear backgrounds and were both human evolvers; they could be somewhat trusted, so Lin Yuan agreed to take them in directly.

“Thank you, Starlord.”

Lu Ran and Ruan Wei relaxed upon hearing this.

They originally thought that being under the Milky Way Starlord wouldn’t be an issue, but when they met Lin Yuan,

they realized they had underestimated the Starlord whose insight into the rules far exceeded their imaginations. Merely sitting there and looking at them made their hearts tremble.

So once again they doubted themselves until Lin Yuan nodded in agreement and they could let go of their concerns.

“You both stay on the main star for now, and if there’s anything that needs to be done later, you can take care of it. You won’t be doing it for nothing,” Lin Yuan said.

In fact, one could exploit followers as much as possible, but Lin Yuan didn’t wish to do that.

A star domain, if developed well, can generate vast benefits; Lin Yuan was willing to share some of that.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Thirteen Peaks.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit was sitting cross-legged deep in the hall.

With Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Taiyang Rule, the presence of the Taiyang Divine Spirit also soared.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit, originally condensed by Lin Yuan from the Power of Taiyang, was closely related to the Taiyang Rule; his comprehension of the Taiyang Rule was clearly beneficial to the elevation of the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“My current strength…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face as the World of Flames within him began to expand wildly until it reached a radius of four hundred thousand li.

It had reached the normal standard of an inner world for an Eighth Rank peak evolver.

“Not weaker than an ordinary Eighth Rank peak,” the Yang God Lin Yuan appraised himself.

With a complete understanding of the Taiyang Rule, for the Taiyang Divine Spirit, that meant being at the peak of the Eighth Layer. Moreover, the Taiyang Divine Spirit wasn’t following the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

Its essence was a Primordial Spirit, and the limit of the rules was its limit.

“Now it’s at the peak of the Eighth Layer, but if I understand the Taiyin Rule, and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit also reaches the peak of the Eighth Layer, what would our combined strength be when we merge into the Taiji Primordial Spirit?” Lin Yuan’s Yang Spirit anticipated inwardly.

The Taiyin and Taiyang Primordial Spirits condensed by Lin Yuan through the Martial Path Evolutionary Path were split from the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

The two could also merge as one.

Moreover, when the Taiyang Divine Spirit and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit are fused, their strength will surge significantly, possibly not weaker than the main body.

At the Seventh Layer, if the Taiyin and Taiyang Primordial Spirits merged, they could even forcefully create a second Taiji microcosm.

“Speaking of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit… I should be able to go to the medium-sized otherworldly battlefield now, right?” the Yang God Lin Yuan pondered.

Eternal Spatial Rifts in the medium-sized otherworldly battlefields are much larger than those in the small-sized ones.

Lin Yuan speculated that being in such large Eternal Spatial Rifts might accelerate the accumulation of the World-Breaking Origin Force.

However, when Lin Yuan was at the Seventh Rank, the Goddess of Wisdom did not advise him to go to the medium-sized otherworldly battlefields, not even with an avatar.

Avatars are not invincible; some unbeatable Eighth Rank as well as Ninth Rank Evolvers have the means to counter avatars.

Lin Yuan was a peerless genius of human civilization and the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the Goddess of Wisdom naturally prioritized safeguarding his safety.

Now that Lin Yuan had stepped into the Eighth Layer, heading to a Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield should pose no problem.

Theoretically speaking, the strongest beings in a Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield are invincible at the Eighth Layer, with a small probability of encountering Ninth Rank powerhouses.

With his Primordial Spirit concealed, blending in, even if an extreme situation arose, he could simply abandon the Primordial Spirit.

Although a Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield was far more dangerous than the marginal Milky Way Star Region.

But Lin Yuan wasn’t going there with his identity exposed, so with it concealed, who would know he was the peerless genius of human civilization?

“Goddess of Wisdom…”

Lin Yuan immediately applied to the Goddess of Wisdom.

Any human Evolver wishing to travel to the Battlefields of Different Races needed to apply to the three goddesses; otherwise, they could not get a Battlefield Pass, which would mean being undocumented and subject to attack from both humans and the Different Species.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, your application has been approved…”

The solemn and cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“As expected, it’s approved.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

With strength reaching the Eighth Layer and identity concealed,

There should be no risk in heading to the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield, which was evident from the Goddess of Wisdom’s approval of the application.

Plus, armed with the Soul-Settling Pearl bestowed by Xia Qin Supreme Being, he was even more secure.

Although the Soul-Settling Pearl was on his true body, the Avatar could still activate it if subjected to memory contamination or similar tactics affecting the main body. It would temporarily free itself from influence and completely control the self-destruction of the Avatar.

…

Small-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit left the Eternal Spatial Rift, exited the battlefield, and headed towards the chosen Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield.

Actually, the most Origin Force-saving method would be for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to stay put and the Yang Spirit to travel to the chosen Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield.

Once the Yang Spirit arrived, the Yin God would depart and return to Chikun Main Star.

However, doing so would risk exposing both the Yang God and Yin God to the starry skies simultaneously.

Lin Yuan would rather waste a bit of World-Breaking Origin Force than take the slightest risk upon himself.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan ended his cultivation.

He scanned the scenes on the main star.

“The development is good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. Under the management of his four Eighth Layer and two Seventh Layer subordinates, the Milky Way Main Star was thriving, and major forces like the nearby Star Domain Trade Associations were beginning to settle in.

“Continue taking stock.”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and he started to inspect his spoils of war.

Hunting those special life forms, the Alien Lone Walkers, earned Lin Yuan a great fortune, especially ‘Shang Shan’ and ‘Ao Du,’ two special beings that contributed to nearly a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals in revenue.

Furthermore, the other special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers also brought Lin Yuan substantial gains.

After collecting recognizable treasures into a unified Space Bracelet, Lin Yuan began to inventory the remaining miscellaneous items.

As special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers, who had lived for eons, they occasionally acquired some treasures they did not recognize and would collect them.

Now all these treasures of unknown origin and use had piled up in Lin Yuan’s possession, almost as large as a mountain range.

“Take a slow look.”

Lin Yuan had a very simple method for dealing with these miscellaneous items of unknown origin and use, and that was to crush them.

Any treasure that could withstand his blow without shattering was likely to have some significance.

Boom, boom, boom.

Lin Yuan’s mind moved slightly.

Hundreds of miscellaneous items suddenly began to deform and turn into chaff.

“Hmm?”

Just as Lin Yuan was about to look away, seemingly having spotted something, his gaze fell on the pile of chaff.

There lay a grey gourd, falling along with the chaff.

“This gourd… it blocked my strike?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

No matter what the use of the gourd was, at least its material was good, and it could be worth a few Cubic Universe Crystals.

“Let’s see what’s different.”

Grasping the gourd, Lin Yuan applied a little force, only to find it unmovable, and his expression gradually changed.

With his current strength, even a slight exertion of force could cause a planet’s tectonic plates to tear apart and plunge into a mass extinction period.

“Hmm?”

With his consciousness probing out and touching the grey gourd, Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.
